tei:div.tei:p: (dkar chag dang po/)༄༅/ 'dir rje sna tshogs rang grol gyi bka' 'bum chos tshan gyi rnam grangs ji ltar bzhugs pa'i rim pa bkod par glegs bam/ cha)pa la/ tshes dpag med gnasam lcags rdo rje dngos grub kun 'dus kyi dbang bskur rgyas pa'i rim pa ji ltar bya tshul ldeb/ 42 tshe sgrub gnas lcags rdo rje'i cha rkyen du gyur pa bka' brgyad dngos grub snying po'i dbang chog ldeb/ 37 zab chos rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang skur gyi las rim bltas chog tu bkod pa ldeb/ 30

(dkar chag gnyis pa/)sbas yul lam yig padma dkar po las gsungs pa'i rdo rje gro lod kyi dbang chog ldeb/ 23 dpal ye shes kyi mgon po ma nig nag po'i srog dbang bka' gtad zab mo'i las rim ldeb/ 21 sgam po mchog sprul gyis 'ja' tshon zab gter tsheg sgrig gis dri rmed gnang ba'i lan ldeb/ 47 phyag chen phyogs nas dris lan yin bzhin nor bu'i de shal la ldeb/ 26 yig drug dmigs rim ldeb/ 1 byang sdom rgyun khyer nyams su blang ba'i cho ga rin chen myu gu ldeb/ 16 dpal ldan bla ma'i dkyil chog nges don byin rlabs chu rgyun ldeb/ 19 bcas/ bzhugs//
